v.place(0,0,0); v.input={throttle:1,steer:0,handbrake:false}; let T=0,t100=null,t60=null; const curve=[]; while(T<12){ v.update(dt,C,0); T+=dt; const k=v.speed*3.6; if(t60===null&&k>=60)t60=+T.toFixed(2); if(t100===null&&k>=100)t100=+T.toFixed(2); if(Math.abs(T-Math.round(T))<dt/2) curve.push(Math.round(k)); } const top12=Math.round(v.speed*3.6); v.place(0,0,0); v.vz=100/3.6; v.input={throttle:-1,steer:0,handbrake:false}; let z0=v.z,bt=0; while(v.speed>0.3&&bt<10){v.update(dt,C,0); bt+=dt;} const brake=+(v.z-z0).toFixed(1); v.place(0,0,0); v.vz=60/3.6; v.input={throttle:0.5,steer:1,handbrake:false}; let st=0,yr90=null; const yrs=[]; for(let i=0;i<180;i++){v.update(dt,C,0); st+=dt; yrs.push(v.yawRate);} const yrMax=Math.max(...yrs.map(Math.abs)); for(let i=0;i<yrs.length;i++) if(Math.abs(yrs[i])>=0.9*yrMax){yr90=+(i*dt).toFixed(2);break;} const latg=+(yrMax*Math.abs(v.speed)/9.81).toFixed(2); v.place(0,0,0); v.vz=80/3.6; v.input={throttle:0.3,steer:1,handbrake:true}; let slip=0; for(let i=0;i<60;i++){v.update(dt,C,0); const fx=Math.sin(v.yaw),fz=Math.cos(v.yaw); const vl=v.vx*fx+v.vz*fz, vt=v.vx*fz-v.vz*fx; slip=Math.max(slip,Math.abs(Math.atan2(vt,Math.abs(vl)))*57.3);} out[t]={t0_60:t60,t0_100:t100,kmh_per_s:curve,kmh_at12s:top12,brake100_m:brake,brakeT_s:+bt.toFixed(2),yaw90_s:yr90,yawMax:+yrMax.toFixed(2),latG60:latg,hbSlipDeg:Math.round(slip)}; __G.scene.remove(v.root);} const g=__G.game; g.tp(170,-300,0); g.cam.yaw=Math.PI; g.override={mx:0,mz:1}; let wt=0,w90=null; const p0=g.P.pos.clone(); for(let i=0;i<90;i++){__G.step(1); wt+=1/30; if(w90===null&&g.curSpeed>=0.9*4.0) w90=+wt.toFixed(2);} const run=+(g.P.pos.distanceTo(p0)/wt).toFixed(2); g.override={mx:0,mz:1,sprint:true}; const p1=g.P.pos.clone(); __G.step(60); const spr=+(g.P.pos.distanceTo(p1)/2).toFixed(2); g.override=null; out.foot={runAvg3s_ms:run,t90_s:w90,sprint_ms:spr}; out

shots.js: const seen=new Set(); let gb=0,ng=0; const tex=new Set(); __G.scene.traverse(o=>{ if(o.geometry&&!seen.has(o.geometry)){ seen.add(o.geometry); ng++; for(const k in o.geometry.attributes){ const a=o.geometry.attributes[k]; gb+=a.array?a.array.byteLength:0;} if(o.geometry.index) gb+=o.geometry.index.array.byteLength; if(o.isInstancedMesh) gb+=o.instanceMatrix.array.byteLength; } const ms=Array.isArray(o.material)?o.material:[o.material]; for(const m of ms){ if(!m) continue; for(const k in m){ const v=m[k]; if(v&&v.isTexture) tex.add(v);} if(m.uniforms) for(const k in m.uniforms){ const v=m.uniforms[k].value; if(v&&v.isTexture) tex.add(v);} } }); let tb=0; const big=[]; for(const t of tex){ const im=t.image; if(!im) continue; const w=im.width||0,h=im.height||0,d=im.depth||1; const b=w*h*d*4*1.33; tb+=b; big.push([Math.round(b/1e6),w+'x'+h+(t.isCanvasTexture?'C':'')]); } big.sort((a,b)=>b[0]-a[0]); ({geomMB:Math.round(gb/1e6),geoms:ng,texMB:Math.round(tb/1e6),ntex:tex.size,big:big.slice(0,15),heap:performance.memory?Math.round(performance.memory.usedJSHeapSize/1e6):0,info:__G.renderer.info.memory})
